sources.title: BERT (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) is a language model introduced in October 2018 by researchers at Google. sources.title: Fine-Tuning a BERT Model - MachineLearningMastery.com
sources.snippet: BERT is a foundational NLP model trained to understand language, but it may not perform well on any specific task out of the box. However, you can build upon BERT by adding appropriate model heads and training it for a specific task. This process is called fine-tuning. In this article, you will learn how to fine-tune a BERT model for several NLP tasks. Let's get started.
